dimensions.name: PREMISE_MATURITY
dimensions.description: Core conflict should match the target reader's autonomy and conceptual range rather than relying on vocabulary to imply maturity.

dimensions.name: NARRATIVE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support layered goals, changing information, reversals, parallel pressures, and earned resolution.

dimensions.name: CONCEPTUAL_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Allow systems, institutions, evidence, ethics, ambiguity, identity, responsibility, and competing explanations at the target level.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_DEPTH
dimensions.description: Important outcomes should arise from several linked causes, decisions, constraints, and consequences.

dimensions.name: INFERENCE_DEMAND
dimensions.description: Allow meaningful unstated connections and interpretation without making essential causality opaque.

dimensions.name: AGENCY_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: The protagonist should make consequential strategic choices among credible alternatives.

dimensions.name: STAKES_CONSEQUENCE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Stakes may affect reputation, relationships, livelihood, access, identity, institutions, safety, or world state without becoming melodramatic by default.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_RELATIONSHIP_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support mixed motives, power differences, trust, conflict, loyalty, negotiation, and changing relationships without flattening people into roles.

dimensions.name: PREDICTABILITY_CHALLENGE
dimensions.description: Avoid obvious one-beat solutions; permit wrong models, reversals, incomplete information, and trade-offs.

dimensions.name: WONDER_DISCOVERY
dimensions.description: Adventure-oriented stories should still offer discovery, exploration, systems, mystery, or experiences larger than routine simulation.

dimensions.name: LANGUAGE_READABILITY
dimensions.description: Use clear, natural language appropriate to an independent adult reader; complexity should come from thought and structure, not unnecessary opacity.

required_story_capabilities: A protagonist with a credible age-appropriate role and independent agency
At least one layered objective, unresolved question, or competing priority
Multi-step causality with consequences that accumulate across the episode
A meaningful change in understanding rather than simple clue collection
A consequential choice, strategic trade-off, or irreversible local action
A local episode payoff that does not prematurely close long-horizon questions
Persistent consequence or reusable world-state value when earned
Adventure-oriented modes should include genuine discovery, exploration, mystery, or systems engagement
reject_signals: A premise made to feel older mainly through harder vocabulary
One obvious attempt solves the central problem without meaningful complication
The protagonist mostly observes while another character resolves the core problem
Exposition or lore substitutes for scene-level causality and choice
Mystery or conflict resolves by coincidence, withheld information, or unearned revelation
Violence, trauma, romance, cynicism, or darkness is added merely to signal maturity
The world could be replaced by a generic setting without materially changing the problem
language_rules: Prefer precise natural language over ornamental density
Domain-specific terminology is allowed when it serves action, reasoning, profession, or world logic and remains understandable in context
Do not use vocabulary difficulty as a substitute for premise or conceptual maturity
Let dialogue, action, evidence, and consequence carry interpretation where practical
Avoid juvenile narration unless the exact character voice or scene intentionally calls for it
safety_rules: Maturity does not require graphic violence, sexual content, trauma, or despair
Tension, danger, loss, rivalry, moral uncertainty, and difficult relationships may appear when relevant and proportionate
Do not force age stereotypes, illness, frailty, parenthood, nostalgia, or romance merely because the reader is older
calibration_notes: Age-18 stories may use adult-scale autonomy, institutions, ethical tension, identity, work/study responsibility, and ambiguous motives without assuming adult life experience.
Do not make the story feel adult merely by adding darker content or denser vocabulary.
Product session length remains separately governed by the cross-age qualification matrix.
Cross-age qualification authority: STANDARD product session is fixed at 1,600–2,500 words for the first controlled 12/18/25/40/60 proof so maturity is isolated from length.

character.name: Leyra

character.current_role: junior boundary cartographer under independent map-seal review

identity_anchors.statement: Leyra believes a map should never claim more than its maker can honestly witness.
Leyra is drawn to impossible places but refuses to call mystery proof.

core_drives.drive: Earn the right to chart places current maps cannot explain.
Keep border communities from paying the price for elegant but wrong maps.

internal_tensions.side_b: powerful desire to cross into the unknown

immediate_desires: prove that wonder and discipline can coexist in serious cartography
immediate_avoidances: inventing certainty because a discovery feels important
being dismissed as a reckless village-born apprentice

world.era: late guild age in a kingdom whose borders are maintained by enchanted survey networks
world.habitat: forested border marches divided by old roads, warded valleys, ruined watch-lines and map-bound settlements
world.technology_level: ink presses, compasses, chain measures, glass lenses, horse travel and guild archives
world.magic_level: strong but rule-bound cartographic magic: witnessed boundaries can be sealed into maps, wardstones answer only to measured lines, and unverified geography cannot safely be written as fact
world.summary: The Veiled Marches are held together by maps that do more than describe roads and borders: once properly witnessed and sealed, they help stabilize them. Old routes sometimes disappear behind ward-lines, and the guild treats sealed passages as dangerous until independently re-surveyed. The magic rewards observation, corroboration and exact wording; a confident false map can be more dangerous than an incomplete one.
social_context: licensed cartographers carry both practical and magical authority
border villages depend on guild maps but bear the consequences when maps are wrong
crossing a sealed boundary without a survey warrant can end an apprenticeship
senior cartographers may maintain private field marks, but those marks are not legal evidence by themselves
old folktales about roads returning are common and usually dismissed as exaggeration
known_pressures: several outer wardstones have become harder to reconcile with legal maps
spring caravans will soon increase traffic through the border marches
Greyfen wants certainty before moving livestock near the old boundary
the guild fears panic caused by unverified claims about forgotten roads

known_world_facts: Leyra is an eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer based at Vellum Hall.
Ashen Gate is legally recorded as sealed and has not been formally reopened.
Greyfen lies beside the eastern ward-line and depends on stable boundary maps.
A legal map-seal requires witnessed survey evidence; private marks and rumors are not enough.
Crossing a sealed boundary without authorization can end an apprenticeship.
Master Ilyan trained Leyra and has never given her a clear account of his earlier Ashen Gate work.
No accepted evidence currently proves why old roads sometimes appear to return.
A private cartographer field mark can prove prior survey presence but not motive or conclusion.

main.title: The Unwritten Border
main.goal: Discover why Ashen Gate and other retired boundary lines can begin answering to roads that legal maps say no longer exist.
main.stakes: Wrongly restoring a dangerous road could expose border communities to unstable magic, while wrongly suppressing a real route could leave the guild blind to a changing world.
main.central_mystery: The old boundary network is changing state according to rules the current guild only partly understands.

eligible_milestones.summary: Leyra documents a repeatable visible or magical response showing that Ashen Gate currently answers to a path the legal map marks as sealed.
eligible_milestones.state_condition: A dated field record establishes one bounded anomaly at Ashen Gate, without proving why the gate changed.
consequence_options: The guild must decide whether a formal re-survey is warranted.

eligible_milestones.summary: Leyra notices an old private field mark associated with Master Ilyan near the exterior survey stones.
eligible_milestones.state_condition: The mark establishes only that Ilyan surveyed or marked this site before; it does not establish why or what he knew.
consequence_options: Leyra's trust question becomes more immediate.

eligible_milestones.summary: A second survey condition confirms the gate response is not a single accidental compass twitch.
eligible_milestones.state_condition: Leyra has corroborating field evidence that the boundary response is real, while cause remains unresolved.
consequence_options: Master Ilyan can no longer dismiss the event as one bad reading.

public_long_term_questions.question: Why do some roads erased from legal maps appear to return?
What did Master Ilyan actually learn at Ashen Gate years ago?

approved_premise.title: The Road the Map Refused to Admit
approved_premise.logline: During a routine re-survey of Ashen Gate, Leyra finds that a century-sealed boundary is answering to a road the legal map insists does not exist, while a private field mark tied to her mentor suggests someone investigated the anomaly before her.
approved_premise.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer preparing for an independent map-seal license in a guild where witnessed geography can become magically binding.
approved_premise.immediate_objective: Establish exactly what Ashen Gate is doing before dusk and decide what she can responsibly report without turning an extraordinary discovery into an unsupported claim.
approved_premise.inciting_event: Leyra's ward-compass and an exterior boundary stone both respond as though a route continues through Ashen Gate, even though the legal map records the passage as sealed.
approved_premise.central_problem: Leyra must separate a genuine change in the boundary from misleading magical residue while pressure from Greyfen and the guild makes both silence and overstatement consequential.
approved_premise.wonder_or_discovery: The sealed arch appears to recognize a line that current maps deny, and an old private survey mark associated with Master Ilyan may be present near the gate without explaining what he knew or why he left it.
approved_premise.stakes: A false reopening claim could make travelers trust an unstable magical road and end Leyra's apprenticeship; ignoring a real boundary change could leave Greyfen relying on a map that no longer describes the world.
constraints: Leyra may survey the exterior markers but may not cross the sealed boundary without authorization.
A private field mark can establish prior presence or survey activity but cannot prove motive, cause or a hidden conspiracy.
One session cannot prove why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or whether other sealed roads are changing.
Any durable map claim must distinguish witnessed response from theory.
approved_premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: Before the useful light and ward-response window fades, Leyra must choose how much time to spend trying to reproduce the gate response versus preserving a bounded report and confronting the fact that her mentor may have marked this place before.
approved_premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Why is Ashen Gate answering to a road erased from legal maps, and what did Master Ilyan actually witness here years ago?
approved_premise.local_payoff: The episode must resolve what Leyra can honestly put on record now. It may establish one bounded Ashen Gate anomaly, but must leave cause, wider scope, the Nameless Vale and Master Ilyan's motives unresolved unless evidence explicitly earns more.
persistent_outcomes_possible: forbidden_passage_observed becomes eligible if Leyra produces a dated bounded field record of the gate response
Greyfen gains a concrete but carefully worded reason to monitor the old boundary
Leyra's professional trust with Master Ilyan may shift based on how she handles incomplete evidence
an authorized follow-up survey may become possible without the passage being declared safe or reopened
world_specific_elements: ward-compasses that answer only to witnessed boundary lines
maps whose sealed claims can stabilize real roads and borders
private cartographer field marks that are informative but not legal proof

creation_constraints: Magic must follow rule-bound cartographic and boundary logic.

forbidden_creations: Arbitrary spellcasting that bypasses surveying and evidence
Early confirmation of the Nameless Vale's purpose
Predetermined proof that Master Ilyan acted maliciously

architect_raw.title: The Road the Map Refused to Admit
architect_raw.story_promise: A junior cartographer stands at a sealed gate that seems to recognize a road the law says is gone. She must prove what she actually witnessed, before dusk, without crossing the line or overstating it, while a mark left by her mentor makes the discovery personal.
architect_raw.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer under Master Ilyan, close to an independent map-seal license, carrying authorized exterior survey access to Ashen Gate.
architect_raw.immediate_objective: Establish exactly what Ashen Gate is doing before the dusk window closes, and decide what can honestly go on record.
architect_raw.central_question: Can Leyra turn an impossible-seeming response into a bounded, corroborated record, without crossing the boundary, inventing a cause, or judging her mentor, before the light fails?
architect_raw.stakes: A false reopening claim could lure travelers onto an unstable road and end Leyra's apprenticeship. Ignoring a real change leaves Greyfen trusting a map that no longer matches the world. Her credibility as a village-born apprentice is on the line either way.
constraints: Leyra may survey the exterior markers but may not cross the sealed boundary.
A private field mark shows prior presence or survey activity only, not motive, cause or conspiracy.
One session cannot prove why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or whether other sealed roads are changing.
Any durable map claim must separate witnessed response from theory.
The Archive of Cinders may be mentioned only. The Nameless Vale may only be foreshadowed.
Only the tools in her inventory are available: ward-compass, survey kit, legal eastern maps, blank field log.
architect_raw.opening_hook: Halfway through a routine re-survey of a gate sealed for a century, Leyra's ward-compass swings hard toward the arch and holds. The legal map in her hand says there is nothing there for it to point at.

logistics_plan.time_window: One afternoon, from the start of the field window to dusk, when useful light and ward response fade.
movement_constraints: Leyra stays outside the sealed boundary at all times.
Travel from Vellum Hall to Greyfen and on to the gate must fit comfortably inside the window.
Every reading must be taken and logged before dusk.
She works alone at the gate with only her own kit.
logistics_plan.feasibility_rationale: The hall and the village are brief setup stops on the way to an authorized exterior survey. Most of the episode happens at the gate, where the time pressure is sharpest.

beats.purpose: Establish Leyra's standards, her license pressure, and the tool and legal framework she will depend on.
beats.character_action: Checks out her survey warrant, compares the legal eastern maps against her kit, and notes in the log that Ilyan has again declined to assign her the old Ashen Gate records.
beats.external_event: A clerk confirms the exterior window closes at dusk and that Ilyan has left for the day without comment on the survey.
beats.new_information: Her warrant covers exterior markers only. The Ashen Gate file is thin, and the legal map is certain about it.
beats.escalation_delta: Sets a firm deadline and a line she cannot legally cross.
beats.state_change: She commits to a strictly procedural survey and enters the field with the rules fresh in mind.
beats.payoff_contribution: Makes her later restraint a matter of character, not a rule she happens to follow.

beats.purpose: Attach community stakes and a personal trust pressure before the anomaly appears.
beats.character_action: Stops to speak with the ward-keepers, answers their questions honestly, and declines to promise certainty she lacks.
beats.external_event: The keepers say they must decide about moving livestock near the old boundary before the spring caravans arrive, and ask for something they can act on.
beats.new_information: Greyfen will act on whatever wording she gives them, so her phrasing has practical consequences.
beats.escalation_delta: Turns a routine survey into one whose report people will rely on.
beats.state_change: Her caution now carries a human cost if she is too vague.
beats.payoff_contribution: Gives the final report a real audience and real consequences.

beats.purpose: Deliver the inciting anomaly through measurement, not exposition.
beats.character_action: Walks the exterior markers with the ward-compass, sets a baseline at the known stones, and logs the first departure from the legal map.
beats.external_event: The compass pulls toward the arch along a line the legal map does not show, and an exterior boundary stone answers the same heading.
beats.new_information: Two instruments point the same way, but it could still be residue or a single fluke.
beats.escalation_delta: A possible real anomaly appears, and so does the temptation to overclaim it.
beats.state_change: Leyra moves from routine survey to active testing.
beats.payoff_contribution: Provides the first entry for the dated field record.

beats.purpose: Show Leyra actively trying to break her own discovery.
beats.character_action: Re-takes readings from different angles and distances with the chain measure, checks the known sealed stones for comparison, and records which results repeat.
beats.external_event: Some readings scatter, the way lingering residue would, but one heading holds steady however she shifts position.
beats.new_information: There is a stable core response along with noisy margins. She can tell which is which but cannot yet explain either.
beats.escalation_delta: The anomaly survives a first skeptical test, which makes it harder to dismiss.
beats.state_change: She has a bounded, repeatable observation and a way to describe the noise honestly.
beats.payoff_contribution: Supplies the witnessed-versus-theory distinction the report will need.

beats.purpose: Bring the mentor question into the physical evidence.
beats.character_action: Follows the stable heading to the base of an exterior survey stone and scrapes away lichen to read a worn field mark she recognizes as Ilyan's.
beats.external_event: The mark sits exactly on the line she has just measured, and its weathering suggests it is old.
beats.new_information: Someone with Ilyan's mark surveyed or marked this spot before. Nothing shows why, or what was concluded.
beats.escalation_delta: The discovery becomes personal and raises the cost of reporting it.
beats.state_change: Leyra must now guard against reading too much into the mark.
beats.payoff_contribution: Creates the trust tension the decision and payoff resolve.

beats.purpose: Apply time pressure and change the kind of problem.
beats.character_action: Notices the response weakening as the light lowers and improvises a way to log successive readings against the fading window.
beats.external_event: Low sun tilts across the arch, the compass response begins to lag, and the useful window visibly shrinks.
beats.new_information: The response seems tied to the light or ward conditions, so time spent now is time lost for later readings.
beats.escalation_delta: Forces a real tradeoff between more testing and securing what she has.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets up the decision as a genuine dilemma.

beats.purpose: Change what the anomaly and the mark mean together.
beats.character_action: Lays the legal map, her log and the mark's position side by side and notices the mark sits on the measured line, not on the legal boundary.
beats.external_event: The stable heading, the stone's answer and the mark align on one axis that the legal map omits.
beats.new_information: The mark seems tied to this line, not to routine boundary upkeep. This is inference only. It does not show what Ilyan knew or intended.
beats.escalation_delta: What looked like residue plus a stray mark now looks like a line someone else also noticed.
beats.state_change: The anomaly stops seeming accidental, but certainty is still out of reach.
beats.payoff_contribution: Gives the final report its most important careful distinction.

beats.purpose: Force a consequential choice under closing light.
beats.character_action: Weighs whether to spend the remaining light on a second independent reading or to secure a clean bounded record now.
beats.external_event: The response dims further and the sun nears the ridge.
beats.new_information: She cannot do both fully, and either choice will show how she handles incomplete evidence.
beats.escalation_delta: Every remaining minute has a price.
beats.state_change: She commits to a path that shapes the ending.
beats.payoff_contribution: Makes the climax and payoff depend on her own judgment.

beats.purpose: Execute the choice under the last of the light.
beats.character_action: Carries out her chosen plan, then drafts the record in careful wording that separates what she saw from what she suspects.
beats.external_event: The response flickers, then fades with the sun.
beats.new_information: She holds a dated record of what happened, and she knows exactly how much it does and does not prove.
beats.escalation_delta: The window closes and the record is all she keeps.
beats.state_change: Her evidence is fixed at whatever level her choice earned.
beats.payoff_contribution: Produces the concrete outcome of the decision.

beats.purpose: Deliver local closure and a forward question.
beats.character_action: Gives the keepers careful wording and prepares what she will submit to the hall, deciding how to bring the mark to Ilyan.
beats.external_event: The keepers accept the bounded wording and agree to watch the boundary.
beats.new_information: A guarded record exists, and the question of what Ilyan saw remains open.
beats.escalation_delta: Shifts the pressure from the gate to the guild and her mentor.
beats.state_change: Greyfen has a concrete reason for caution, and Leyra has a hard conversation ahead.
beats.payoff_contribution: Answers the central question while leaving the larger mysteries open.

escalation_ladder: A routine survey has a hard dusk deadline and a fixed legal line.
Greyfen will act on whatever wording she chooses.
Two instruments disagree with the legal map.
Part of the response proves to be noise, which tests her honesty.
A mentor's old mark appears on her measured line.
The fading light forces a tradeoff.
The alignment reinterprets the anomaly, and she must resist overclaiming.
She must commit to a path and live with the evidence it yields.

reversal.prior_belief: The response might be lingering residue or a fluke, and the mark a routine leftover unrelated to it.

evidence.claim: A stable compass heading and a matching stone response persisted across varied positions while other readings scattered.
An old private field mark attributed to Ilyan sits on the same measured line.
The response weakens as the light lowers, suggesting dependence on light or ward conditions.
Someone may have known or suspected this line before her, reason unknown.

reversal.reinterpretation: The response is a real, repeatable, bounded anomaly along a line the legal map omits, and the mark sits on that line. It was not a stray leftover on a routine boundary.
reversal.inference_ceiling: The mark shows prior survey presence or marking at this spot. It does not show motive, knowledge or conclusions. Cause and scope remain unproven.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: Why the gate answers this line, what Ilyan saw, whether other sealed roads do the same, and what lies beyond.

decision_point.pressure: The response is fading with the light. Leyra cannot both extend her testing and finish a clean, well-documented record.

branches.option: Use the remaining light to seek a second independent reading of the response.
branches.immediate_action: Re-position, use a different method and recheck the stone and compass against each other before the window closes.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: If it succeeds, the response is corroborated beyond a single reading. The written record is left hurried.
branches.cost_or_risk: The light may fail before she has written anything careful, and a rushed log risks sloppy wording or a muddled record.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Stronger evidence can make Ilyan and the guild take the matter seriously, but a messy submission weakens her standing.
branches.climax_requirement: She must run the second test and then write the record in the last minutes of light.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: A corroborated response with a hurried but honest record; it supports a follow-up survey request.

branches.option: Stop testing and write a careful, bounded, dated record now, including the mark's location.
branches.immediate_action: Take final measurements of the established response, sketch the mark's position relative to the line, and draft the claim with explicit limits.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: A single-session record with clear wording and no corroboration beyond what she already repeated.
branches.cost_or_risk: Lack of a second independent reading leaves room for the guild to dismiss it as one bad observation.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Shows disciplined judgment and gives Ilyan a record he must answer, but the evidence is thinner.
branches.climax_requirement: She must produce precise wording before the response fades and resist pressure to add more.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: A clean, honest record that defines one bounded anomaly and supports a cautious Greyfen advisory.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Whether the response can be corroborated again before it fades, and how Ilyan and the guild will react to the mark.

architect_raw.climax: As the last light leaves the arch, Leyra carries out her chosen plan and fixes her record before the response fades. She holds the line between what she watched happen and what she believes, knowing the mark tempts her to claim more. The gate goes quiet, leaving only what she managed to witness and write.
architect_raw.local_payoff: Leyra puts on record exactly what she earned: a dated, bounded account of Ashen Gate responding along a line the legal map omits, worded to separate observation from theory, with the location of Ilyan's old mark noted as presence only. Greyfen gets careful, actionable wording. The cause, wider scope, Ilyan's purpose and the Nameless Vale remain unresolved.
architect_raw.forward_hook: Ilyan's mark was here before her. Whatever he concluded, he never put it on any map she has been allowed to read, and Leyra must now decide how to ask him.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: A dated field record of one bounded Ashen Gate response along a line absent from the legal map, with witnessed facts separated from hypotheses.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the delivered prose shows Leyra logging the response with limits and method.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Ilyan's old private field mark recorded on the measured line, as evidence of prior presence only.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the prose shows her finding and noting it without inferring motive.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Leyra's trust in Ilyan becomes more immediate and strained, depending on how she frames the mark.
